checks.detail: Frozen public records do not provide exact construct sequences and boundaries. Reference and canonical mappings are useful derived views, but none may be promoted to construct confidence A or B.
Public HuRI records do not reconstruct the complete selected, attempted, technically evaluable pair universe. Unreported pairs remain unknown and may not be converted into negatives.

The deterministic reconciliation quantifies detailed evidence, unique gene and ORF projections, orientations, self-pairs, and pair-view membership, but the public records do not exactly reproduce the provider headline transformation for HuRI or HI-II-14.
SIFTS declares UniProt 2026.03 while the frozen sequence corpus is UniProt 2026_02. Exact structure mapping and structure-derived labels remain blocked.
